suggestions: Assertion list misses facts this response gives: tostring(tokens) and Lua float truncation; cost > capacity is always denied; cost <= 0 is not validated; slow Redis blocks until the client timeout; the raw API key is visible in Redis key names; every replica must use the same config; denials also write state.
The response is about 3.5x longer than the skill runs and retains the same fact count. The length buys extra correct edge cases, not extra listed facts.
eval_feedback.overall: All 15 facts retained accurately in 6650 chars. No clear factual errors found. One minor imprecision: it says a cost > capacity request is told to retry 'in about 1 second', but retry_after = ceil((cost - tokens)/rate), which grows with cost (for example, cost=500 at a full bucket gives 3). The Redis-version claims (TIME then a write needs Redis 5+ effects replication; multi-field HSET needs 4.0+) are correct.
